North Flight (Summer Tracksuit) runs in

The 'Big Sis' from the training club North Flight used to attend.
If I consult her, maybe we can find a solution.

I was so focused on them being a 'midsummer fashion accessory'
that I completely forgot their original purpose.
Your perspective offered a completely fresh angle, and it helped tremendously.

Flight began wearing sunglasses during breaks and while moving between locations.
As we continued training while monitoring her condition over several days...

It definitely seems worth trying!
Let's put it into practice right away!

That's... true. Taking it easy and not rushing is what matters most.
Let's run outside again in the evening once it cools down!

Looking at them again, they really are fantastic...!
I think these are going into heavy rotation this season♪

Even so, combining a school tracksuit with sunglasses
was a rather unusual sight.

Ah... I'm sorry. I'm okay.
I just felt a little dizzy for a second.

It happened one day, some time after
I became North Flight's trainer.

Yes, maybe because my eyes and brain are less strained, I fall asleep much easier at night.
Plus, wearing them gives me a real motivation boost, in a way...

In some countries overseas, students are even encouraged to wear sunglasses to school.
After all, sunglasses were originally created for practical purposes...

UV damage is a major factor in physical fatigue.
The amount entering through the eyes is substantial and reportedly causes mental stress too.

Exactly! Being able to stay fashionable during training makes it so much fun.
I picked these frames out down to the millimeter to perfectly suit my face shape, you know.

Since they'd obstruct vision while running, it's best to take them off then,
but let's cut down on sun exposure diligently and compare your fatigue levels!
Right! Haaaaaah!

Diligently wiping off sweat, reapplying sunscreen,
and remembering to replenish water and electrolytes... Gulp, gulp... Phew...

It's gotten hot all of a sudden lately.
We need to make sure we're properly mindful of temperature swings!

My, that much?
Fufufu...!
...Whoops, whoa...

Haa, haa, haa... Wheeeeew!
All right, running workout complete!
—"Sunglasses"?

Using the information about North Flight's constitution as a base,
I researched from an unconventional angle and arrived at...

No, not at all!
It might be an unusual combo, but it's not against school regulations either.
—Haa, haa, haa, haa!

Trainer, you truly are
my personal stylist dedicated to making me shine.

North Flight delivered great runs day after day.
She showed no signs of illness during training either.

Ehehe, I got praised♪
Come to think of it, I haven't used these much lately...

"—She fell ill in a similar manner once before.
It seems fatigue accumulated from UV rays even more than the heat itself."

—My body feels light even after training.
Looks like Operation Sunglasses is a success!

Yeah... It really does ease the irritation in my eyes.
I didn't even notice until I tried these on. All that accumulated strain, that is.

She was right.
It had suddenly grown warmer lately, and the sun was blazing harshly down.

Countermeasures against the heat, huh... But North Flight was naturally thorough,
and it seemed she was already taking just about every precaution she could.
